title: Lead Ads for a Stove Retailer
description: Educational ad concepts that open with a real buying mistake and lead into a free 'stove check' quiz.

thumbnail.alt: Lead ad: 'Der häufigste Fehler beim Kaminofen? Zu viel Leistung.'

objective: Generate qualified enquiries from people early in their research – without a hard sales message.
insight: Buyers fear making an expensive mistake. Naming the most common one builds trust faster than any discount.
approach: Lead with expertise, not with price
Visualise the answer (room size → power) so the ad is useful on its own
One clear next step: the free 2-minute stove check
